title: Read the details!
text: Read the details!. This is just what we expected - everything but the material.  Nice wooden handle, but we missed the fact that the little dishes are plastic and so small.  We have big groups of folks visiting - and relishes, snacks, etc. would only last through one pass around. It’s attractive - and would be find for nuts, etc.  Was just hoping for something larger, and made out of porcelain.
